I have 3.52 hectares of maize to cultivate by hand here in Arusha, which is a lot of land for my family alone, so I will hire workers to help with planting and weeding. Because the agricultural extension officers here often advise us to use improved seed and fertilizer, and there is a voucher program that makes chemical fertilizer affordable, I will plant improved maize and apply some urea and DAP. Our soils are fertile and the vuli or masika rains are usually reliable in the Northern Highlands, so I do not need to irrigate, and I will not waste money on pesticides for maize when the risk is low.
